title: Signed month seal v1
description: One month's events as they stood at sealed_at, made by sealOf, chained to the school's previous seal, and an Ed25519 signature over its canonical form. One per line in schools/<id>/ledger/seals.jsonl, append-only.

events.description: The month's events with ingest_time at or before sealed_at.

events_hash.description: sha256 of the counted events' canonical forms, sorted by id and joined by a newline.

prev_seal_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical form of the school's previous signed seal; null on its first.

sig.description: Ed25519 over the seal's canonical form, base64url without padding.
